description: Read-only Monad lending pre-signing gate for direct Aave V3 or an exact Morpho Blue market. Separately evaluates collateral and loan oracle integrity, checks caller-declared post-action LTV against live protocol parameters, and returns ALLOW / CAUTION / BLOCK. It never signs, broadcasts, or authorizes a transaction; bind a successful decision to an exact user-authorized transaction separately.
name: monad_lending_guard
